edit.description: Three joined edits, all off one re-fetch of code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks. (1) `hookDefaultContract`'s header (:1722, the hold paragraph at :1731) holds the handler schema unclaused on the premise that "a clause over it would range over a field the read never surfaces" — false at HEAD (see notes). Retire the hold paragraph; the header keeps the event clause's rationale and states why the handler fields are addressable. (2) Ship the handler clauses the kind's own `guidance` (:418) already teaches, in `mcpServerDefaultContract`'s shape (:1798): an `enumOf` over the documented handler `type` set beside a new `DOCUMENTED_HOOK_HANDLER_TYPES` const (the `DOCUMENTED_HOOK_EVENTS` idiom, :1689), then one `when(enumOf("type", [...]), [...])` per handler kind carrying that kind's documented required fields. An absent `type` passes, as it does for `mcp-server`. (3) The `Hook` interface (:382) types four fields where the docs table names the handler-kind fields plus the common ones, so an author can spell only a command handler — widen it to the table, each field carrying its own cite, so every handler kind an author may write is one the clauses can judge.

The embedded built-in lock gains the new `hook.*` clause rows beside `hook.enum.event` (:302). Regenerated by re-running the memberless emit its header describes, never hand-edited; `tests/builtin_lock_frozen.rs` drives the live SDK emit through the engine reader and proves the rows were derived.

The tests that fail on the pre-fix tree, in the module's existing idiom (`write_settings` + `check_harness`, the `coverage.checked` vacuity pin before every silence): a `command` handler with no `command` fires its guarded clause, an `http` handler with no `url` fires its own, a handler whose `type` is outside the documented set fires the enum, and a well-formed handler of each documented kind passes all of them.
The kind x clause matrix gains the hook row's new cells — regenerated by `cargo insta`, reviewed as the ship-time diff the suite exists to produce.

The composition cell: the corpus carries one hook member, a command handler (`sessionHook`, :131), and no `mcp-server` at all, so no guarded clause is exercised over a manifest member anywhere in it. Add a second, legal hook member of a non-command handler kind (an `http` handler with its `url`) so a `when`-guarded clause composes over a group-array entry beside the object-shape and scalar-shape registrations already there.
Regenerated: the gauntlet's projected `settings.json` gains the new hook member's matcher group.
Regenerated if the new member moves the verdict at all — a legal handler should leave it unchanged, which is itself the assertion to review.

The SDK-side pin beside the existing `hookDefaultContract.length > 0` assertion (:657): the contract carries a guarded clause per documented handler kind, so a handler kind added to the type without its clause fails in TypeScript's own suite rather than only in the Rust matrix.

summary: The `hook` default contract holds its handler schema unclaused behind a premise the read falsified: each handler's own fields land on the member, so the documented rules are spellable.

tests.asserts: a command handler missing `command`, an http handler missing `url`, and an undocumented handler `type` each fire their clause, while a well-formed handler of every documented kind passes — each behind the coverage.checked vacuity pin
a non-command hook member composes legally in the kitchen-sink corpus and the check verdict is unchanged

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the regenerated lock and snapshots (`builtin_lock_frozen` and the matrix diff reviewed), the new hook_kind clause tests failing on the pre-fix tree, and `pnpm --dir sdk test` green.
notes: Premise falsified on disk: `hook_member_fields` (`src/json_manifest.rs:628`) flattens each handler's own keys onto the member, pinned at `tests/hook_kind.rs:107`, and `to_unit` (:100) feeds them to the shared fold — so `type`/`command` address by bare name, no path into the array. Not fork-held: `(hook-member-identity)` governs address resolution, not clause evaluation. The two discharged-0041 archive paragraphs (:1070, :1792) ride this entry. scoped at 16f9f66f
